verdict.rationale: Fin's first-party materials name the main parts of an ongoing QA loop. Custom AI Scorecards and CX Score cover scoring, and Monitors and Incident Detection cover flagging failures. Insights evaluates every live Fin conversation, and AI Recommendations is described as the way to understand, measure and improve. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how scored samples and flagged failures are routed to human reviewers, documented mechanics for how review findings turn into fixes in Fin's guidance, content or procedures, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
